question: What auspicious knowledge does the speaker now wish to hear concerning the way in which time deceives?
premises: The speaker now wishes to hear something.
The object of hearing is the deception of time.
That knowledge is described as auspicious.
inference: Now I wish to hear the auspicious account of the deception of time.
uncertainties: Content of that account not given
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
